skill.summary: Understands Malayalam and Manglish WhatsApp messages and replies politely using culturally appropriate language in matching script style.

latestVersion.changelog:
Malayalam WhatsApp Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Detects and understands both Malayalam script and Manglish in WhatsApp messages.
- Responds politely and appropriately in the language/style the user uses.
- Handles common greetings, questions, and cultural nuances.
- Includes style guide for respectful Malayalam and Manglish replies.
